sections.title: Usage
Examples
sections.markdown:
## Examples

### Metadata hooks

Metadata backed by `Map`:

```js
const meta = new Map()
const metadata = {
  get: (key) => (meta.has(key) ? meta.get(key) : null),
  put: (key, value) => meta.set(key, value),
  del: (key) => meta.delete(key)
}

const drive = new Localdrive('./my-app', { metadata })

// ...
```

Note: `metadata.del()` will also be called when metadata is `null`:

```js
await drive.put('/file.txt', Buffer.from('a')) // Default metadata is null
```

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Creates a drive based on a `root` directory. `root` can be relative or absolute.

options.name: followLinks
options.description: If enabled then `entry(key)` will follow the `linkname`

options.name: atomic
options.description: Enable atomicity for file writing (tmp file and rename)

options.name: roots
options.description: For mapping key prefixes to different roots

methods.name: ready
methods.description: No-op. Exists for API compatibility with Hyperdrive.
examples: await drive.ready()

methods.name: close
methods.description: No-op. Exists for API compatibility with Hyperdrive.
examples: await drive.close()

methods.name: flush
methods.description: No-op. Exists for API compatibility with Hyperdrive.
examples: await drive.flush()

methods.name: batch
methods.description:
Returns the drive itself. Exists for API compatibility with Hyperdrive,
which supports write-batching.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description:
Returns the drive itself. Exists for API compatibility with Hyperdrive,
which supports version checkouts.
examples:
const snapshot = drive.checkout()
// on Localdrive, snapshot === drive

methods.name: toPath
methods.returns: Absolute filesystem path for the given key.
methods.description:
Converts a drive key (unix-style path) into an absolute filesystem path
under `drive.root`.
examples:
const drive = new Localdrive('/srv/data')
drive.toPath('/images/logo.png') // => '/srv/data/images/logo.png'

methods.name: entry
methods.returns: Returns the entry at `name` path in the drive.
methods.description: Available `options`:

methods.name: get

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key of the file to read (e.g. `/blob.txt`).

params.name: opts
params.description: `options` are the same as in `drive.entry` method.

methods.returns: Returns the blob at `key` path in the drive.
methods.description: It also returns null for symbolic links.
examples:
const buffer = await drive.get('/blob.txt')
console.log(buffer.toString()) // => 'example'

methods.name: put

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key of the file to write (e.g. `/images/logo.png`).

methods.returns: Resolves when the file has been fully written and closed.
methods.description: Creates a file at `key` path in the drive. `options` are the same as in `createWriteStream`.
examples:
await drive.put('/blob.txt', Buffer.from('example'))
await drive.put('/images/logo.png', Buffer.from('..'), { executable: false })

methods.name: del

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key of the file to delete (e.g. `/images/old-logo.png`).

methods.returns: Resolves when the file and any empty parent directories have been removed.
methods.description: Deletes the file at `key` path from the drive.
examples: await drive.del('/images/old-logo.png')

methods.name: symlink

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key where the symlink will be created.

params.name: linkname
params.description: Target path the symlink should point to.

methods.returns: Resolves when the symlink entry has been created.
methods.description: Creates an entry in drive at `key` path that points to the entry at `linkname`.
examples: await drive.symlink('/images/logo.shortcut', '/images/logo.png')

methods.name: compare

params.name: a
params.description: First entry (must have an `mtime` property in milliseconds).

params.name: b
params.description: Second entry (must have an `mtime` property in milliseconds).

methods.returns: Returns `0` if entries are the same, `1` if `entryA` is older, and `-1` if `entryB` is older.
methods.description: Compares two drive entries by modification time.

methods.name: list
methods.returns: Returns a stream of all entries in the drive inside of specified `folder`.
methods.description: Available `options`:

options.name: ignore
options.description: Ignore file and folders by name.

methods.name: readdir
methods.returns: Returns a stream of all subpaths of entries in drive stored at paths prefixed by `folder`.
methods.description:
Returns an async iterator that yields the immediate child names (not
full paths) under `folder`. Only non-empty sub-directories and files with
a valid entry are included.

methods.name: exists
methods.returns: Whether an entry exists at the given path.
methods.description: Returns `true` if a file (or symlink) entry exists at `name`, `false` otherwise.
examples:
const found = await drive.exists('/blob.txt')
console.log(found) // => true or false

methods.name: mirror

params.name: out
params.description: Destination drive (must implement the same drive API).

methods.returns: A MirrorDrive instance that runs the mirror operation.
methods.description: Efficiently mirror this drive into another. Returns a [`MirrorDrive`](https://github.com/holepunchto/mirror-drive#api) instance constructed with `options`.

methods.name: createReadStream

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key of the file to stream (e.g. `/blob.txt`).

methods.returns: Returns a stream to read out the blob stored in the drive at `key` path.
methods.description: Available `options`:

methods.name: createWriteStream

params.name: key
params.description: Drive key of the file to write (e.g. `/blob.txt`).

methods.returns: Writable stream targeting the given key.
methods.description: Stream a blob into the drive at `key` path.

methods.name: root
methods.description: String with the resolved (absolute) drive path.

methods.name: supportsMetadata
methods.description: Boolean that indicates if the drive handles or not metadata. Default `false`.

typedefs.name: LocaldriveOptions
typedefs.description: Options for creating a Localdrive instance.

properties.name: followLinks
properties.description: If enabled, `entry(key)` follows the `linkname` for symlinks.

properties.name: followExternalLinks
properties.description: If enabled, symlinks pointing outside the root are followed.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Hook functions called when metadata is read/written/deleted.

properties.name: metadata.get
properties.description: Called with `(key)` to retrieve metadata for a file.

properties.name: metadata.put
properties.description: Called with `(key, value)` to store metadata for a file.

properties.name: metadata.del
properties.description: Called with `(key)` to delete metadata for a file.

properties.name: atomic
properties.description: Enable atomic file writes (write to a tmp file then rename).

properties.name: follow
properties.description: Follow symlinks when resolving the key.

properties.name: executable
properties.description: Mark the written file as executable (chmod 0o755).

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Arbitrary metadata value stored via the metadata hook.

properties.name: ignore
properties.description: File/folder paths to exclude. May be a path string, an array of path strings, or a predicate function `(key) => boolean`.

properties.name: start
properties.description: Byte offset to start reading from (inclusive).

properties.name: end
properties.description: Byte offset to stop reading at (inclusive). Ignored when `length` is set.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Number of bytes to read. Overrides `end`.

properties.name: dryRun
properties.description: List differences without writing any changes.

properties.name: prune
properties.description: Remove files in the destination that are not in the source.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Predicate `(key) => boolean` to include only matching entries.

properties.name: batch
properties.description: Use batched writes on a Hyperdrive destination.
